rooms.caption: A slow cage rattle, ventilation and one distant bell.
rooms.purpose: Compare separately labeled power and link indications; no sound proves communication
rooms.inspectionText: Read the power indication and the link indication separately on the lift panel. A running fan tells you what the machinery is doing.

rooms.caption: Soft furnace breath, leather bellows and cooling metal ticks.
rooms.purpose: Hear a workshop at rest; route selection and notebook remain text actions
rooms.inspectionText: Use the briefing and notebook to choose a route. The furnace continues to work while you read or change your mind.

rooms.caption: Low motor hum and restrained cable-tray vibration.
rooms.purpose: Distinguish atmosphere from measured continuity or interference evidence
rooms.inspectionText: Inspect the run and record its continuity and test results. Cable-tray vibration is part of the room whether the run passes or fails.

rooms.caption: Sparse drips and a short cavern response to distant machinery.
rooms.purpose: Reverberation is mood; regeneration cannot bridge the displayed break
rooms.inspectionText: Inspect the displayed break before deciding where regeneration could help. The echoes describe the size of the cavern.

rooms.caption: Air moving through glass reeds and a soft mechanical garden ventilation bed.
rooms.purpose: Optical light stays light; no electrical-power claim or guaranteed parallel payload lanes
rooms.inspectionText: Inspect the emitters, receivers and declared optical profile. Movement in the glass reeds comes from the garden air handler.

rooms.caption: Low resonant glass tone with occasional mechanical shutter breath.
rooms.purpose: Loss, level, margin and overload remain numeric accessible observations
rooms.inspectionText: Read launch and receive levels, loss, margin and overload on the test equipment. The shutter moves on its own schedule.

rooms.caption: Steady open-air wind and a restrained mast creak.
rooms.purpose: Wind is not a universal signal-quality or throughput meter
rooms.inspectionText: Read the radio observations and compare the declared link profiles. Wind passing the mast provides a sense of open space.

rooms.caption: Rain against dome and remote thunder without sudden peaks.
rooms.purpose: Text records channel, signal and noise; thunder does not select the correct channel
rooms.inspectionText: Read the channel, signal and noise results on the instruments. The dome shelters the apprentice from the storm during comparisons.

rooms.caption: Soft market room tone, cooling electronics and restrained shell clicks.
rooms.purpose: Keep connector fit, supported profile and delivered power as separate checks
rooms.inspectionText: Check connector fit, supported profile and delivered power separately. Shells tapping on a counter are market activity.

rooms.caption: Slow escapement and soft belt movement, no urgent countdown.
rooms.purpose: Timing is a toy signal lesson; main progress never requires beat matching
rooms.inspectionText: Use the step controls to examine the timing exercise at your own pace. The escapement keeps moving while you read.

rooms.caption: Distant idling engine, loose grit and intermittent harmless settling.
rooms.purpose: Danger is narrated and paused for decisions; never conceal a route-closing choice
rooms.inspectionText: Read the safety warning and the stated consequences before committing a route. The distant excavator idles while decisions are paused.

rooms.caption: Gentle ventilation and distant city machinery, with an occasional wind chime.
rooms.purpose: A gate reached is not a successful test; future realm boundary remains explicit
rooms.inspectionText: Run a fresh link measurement and endpoint test, then read the outcome. The far city is audible from this side of the boundary.
